correctness.rationale: The exact normal differential of the defining ellipsoid is β²/r transversely. The cited billiard Poincaré block reduces the normal derivative to a strictly positive 2x2 product; its exact projective recurrence yields |u_i−β^-2/a_i|≤β^-4/(a_*²d_*). A one-step log comparison gives 3β^-4/(a_*²d_*²), and Birkhoff yields the two invariant coefficients. Planar branch boundedness and transverse expansion select the top exponent at sufficiently large β. No numerical extrapolation is used.
